# 01 Import Wave 11

This script imports the Wave 11 raw data files and saves the processed dataset list and dataset summary.
Later scripts read the saved RDS files rather than importing the raw tables again.

## Load shared settings

```{r}
source(here::here("script", "00_packages.R"))
```

## List dictionary files

```{r}
dict_files <- tibble::tribble(
  ~table, ~file_name,
  "w11_main", "5050_wave_11_elsa_data_eul_data_dictionary.xlsx",
  "w11_ifs", "5050_wave_11_ifs_derived_variables_ukda_data_dictionary.xlsx",
  "w11_financial", "5050_wave_11_financial_derived_variables_ukda_data_dictionary.xlsx",
  "w11_nurse", "5050_wave_11_elsa_nurse_data_eul_data_dictionary.xlsx",
  "w11_pensiongrid", "5050_wave_11_elsa_pensiongrid_eul_data_dictionary.xlsx",
  "w11_lifehistory", "5050_wave_11_elsa_lifehistory02_data_dictionary.xlsx",
  "w11_eol", "5050_w11_elsa_eol_data_dictionary.xlsx"
)
```

## List raw data files

```{r}
wave11_files <- tibble::tribble(
  ~table, ~file_name,
  "w11_main", "wave_11_elsa_data_eul.tab",
  "w11_ifs", "wave_11_ifs_derived_variables.tab",
  "w11_financial", "wave_11_financial_derived_variables.tab",
  "w11_nurse", "wave_11_elsa_nurse_data_eul.tab",
  "w11_pensiongrid", "wave_11_elsa_pensiongrid_eul.tab",
  "w11_lifehistory", "wave_11_elsa_lifehistory02_data_eul.tab",
  "w11_eol", "wave_11_elsa_eol_eul.tab"
)
```

## Import Wave 11 tables

```{r}
# Keep the imported tables in a named list for consistent downstream access.
w11_datasets <- setNames(
  lapply(wave11_files$file_name, function(file_name) {
    readr::read_tsv(
      file.path(wave11_path, file_name),
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
  }),
  wave11_files$table
)

data11_main <- w11_datasets$w11_main
data11_ifs <- w11_datasets$w11_ifs
data11_financial <- w11_datasets$w11_financial
data11_nurse <- w11_datasets$w11_nurse
data11_pensiongrid <- w11_datasets$w11_pensiongrid
data11_lifehistory <- w11_datasets$w11_lifehistory
data11_eol <- w11_datasets$w11_eol
```

## Check imported table sizes

```{r}
dataset_summary <- data.frame(
  dataset = names(w11_datasets),
  n_rows = sapply(w11_datasets, nrow),
  n_cols = sapply(w11_datasets, ncol),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

dataset_summary
```

## Save imported objects

```{r}
saveRDS(
  w11_datasets,
  file.path(processed_path, "01_wave11_datasets.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  dataset_summary,
  file.path(processed_path, "01_wave11_dataset_summary.rds")
)

message("Wave 11 datasets have been imported successfully.")
message("Saved: data/processed/01_wave11_datasets.rds")
message("Saved: data/processed/01_wave11_dataset_summary.rds")
```
